Could your family find the important information they need during an emergency? A simple family emergency information sheet can keep key contacts, medications and allergies, school or child-care information, and meeting places organized. Prepare it, store it securely, and review it every 6 months. Planning resource: https://www.ready.gov/plan

The Prepared Parent Project — Preparing Alabama parents. Strengthening Alabama families.

#PreparedParent #FamilyPreparedness #AlabamaFamilies
